title: Mobile onboarding design review
segments: Nam
Hi all, this is the design review for the new mobile onboarding. Linh, can you walk us through it?
Linh
Sure. We cut onboarding from seven screens to four. Users now pick a language first, Vietnamese or English, then sign in.
Linh
In the last usability test with eight users, completion went from 62 percent to 85 percent.
Ben
Nice. But the permission screen still asks for contacts, notifications and location all at once. That feels aggressive.
Linh
Fair. We could ask for notifications only during onboarding and request location later, when the user opens the map.
Nam
Let's do that. Contacts permission should be removed entirely for now, we don't use it yet.
Ben
The Vietnamese copy on screen two is too long, 'Chào mừng bạn đến với ứng dụng quản lý cuộc họp thông minh' gets cut off on small phones.
Linh
Ừ đúng rồi, I'll shorten it to 'Chào mừng bạn' and move the rest to a subtitle.
Nam
Also, dark mode isn't in the mockups yet. Marketing wants the launch on December 10th.
Linh
Dark mode for these four screens is about two days of work. I'll have it ready by next Tuesday.
Ben
Engineering needs final assets by November 25th to make the December 10th release.
Nam
Okay. Linh delivers final assets by the 25th, Ben starts implementing the language picker now since that design is final.
Ben
One more thing: we should track drop-off per screen with analytics events.
Nam
Agreed, Ben adds analytics events for each onboarding step.

key_points.point: Onboarding cut from seven to four screens; language picker first
Ask only for notifications in onboarding, location later, remove contacts
Vietnamese copy on screen two too long; shorten to 'Chào mừng bạn' + subtitle
Dark mode missing; ~2 days, ready next Tuesday
Launch December 10; final assets due November 25
Track drop-off per screen with analytics events

action_items.text: Linh delivers dark mode by next Tuesday
Linh delivers final assets by Nov 25
Ben adds analytics events per step
